Hi Sophie / Raj -

Appreciate the clear numbers - below are recommendations / assumptions for sizing and a short technical plan to meet the SLOs you outlined. I attached a quick "SLO-sizing-estimate.xlsx" with region-by-region capacity math.

Assumptions we used:
- Working model: mixed streaming + sync generation; model family assumed is an LLM variant with modest KV cache persistence (~8GB per node).
- Average request size: 120 tokens; peak context length 2k tokens for a small subset.
- Token compute characteristics assume float16/quantized runtime with batching benefits for non-latency-critical tokens.

Recommendations / plan:
1) Regional clusters: provision dedicated Dedicated pools (or Private clusters) per region: US (us-west-2), EU (eu-west-1), APAC (sg-1). This lets us meet residency and routing requirements and avoid cross-region tails.
2) Routing: edge routing tier to route by customer tenant -> regional cluster. For burst/surge, we can configure cross-region fallback to the nearest compatible cluster but only for non-residency-bound tenants (we'll honor strict residency flags).
3) Streaming & token latency: use continuous batching with an aggressive timeout max 5ms to preserve p95. For streaming sessions, prioritize single-token path (no batching) for first-increment, then enable small micro-batches for subsequent tokens to improve throughput.
4) Concurrency model: support 80 concurrent sessions by sizing GPU instances for ~10-12 concurrent streaming encoders per GPU (depends on model choice). See attachment for node counts per region.
5) KV cache and reconnects: persist per-session KV cache in regional cache stores with 1 hour TTL to allow quick reconnects. On reconnect, client sends last acked token index to avoid duplication.
6) Fallbacks: define automatic fallback to a smaller, cheaper model variant during 5-10% failure/overload windows to keep latency SLOs while sacrificing some output quality.
7) Observability: we'll instrument per-tenant p50/p95/p99 token latencies, queue times, and batch sizes; expose per-route traces for your ops team.

Next steps (technical):
- I've attached SLO-sizing-estimate.xlsx (region-by-region nodes and config).
- If this looks good, we can provision a canary cluster in EU + US with the suggested configs for a 2-week soak.
- I'll prepare a short runbook for streaming reconnect flows and for configuring residency flags (link below).

Links:

- Runbook (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B-SLO-qual
